items.subject: english
items.title: 状语从句
items.text: Adverbial clauses express time, condition, reason, purpose, result, concession or comparison. Choose a conjunction according to the logical relation.
items.translation: 状语从句表达时间、条件、原因、目的、结果、让步或比较关系，应根据逻辑关系选择连词。

items.subject: english
items.title: 主谓一致
items.text: The finite verb agrees with the grammatical subject, not necessarily with the nearest noun. Identify the true subject before choosing the verb form.
items.translation: 限定动词要与语法主语一致，不一定与最近的名词一致。选择动词形式前应先找出真正主语。

items.subject: english
items.title: 冠词与介词
items.text: Articles show whether a noun is general, specific or unique. Prepositions express time, place, direction and abstract relations and should be learned with collocations.
items.translation: 冠词表示名词是泛指、特指还是独一无二。介词表达时间、地点、方向和抽象关系，应结合搭配学习。

items.subject: english
items.title: 比较结构
items.text: Comparative structures express equality, difference, superiority or progressive change. Keep the comparison target clear and grammatically parallel.
items.translation: 比较结构表达相同、不同、优劣或渐进变化。要明确比较对象，并保持比较两端语法形式平行。

items.subject: english
items.title: 虚拟语气
items.text: The subjunctive presents unreal, hypothetical or desired situations. Conditional forms change according to whether the condition concerns the present, past or future.
items.translation: 虚拟语气表示非真实、假设或愿望。条件句形式会根据假设针对现在、过去还是将来而变化。

items.subject: english
items.title: 倒装与强调
items.text: Partial inversion places an auxiliary before the subject after certain negative or restrictive expressions. The emphatic pattern is It is or was ... that or who ....
items.translation: 部分倒装在某些否定或限制性表达之后把助动词置于主语之前。强调句基本结构为 It is/was ... that/who ...。

commonErrors: 强调句与定语从句混淆

items.subject: english
items.title: 情态动词
items.text: Modal verbs express ability, possibility, permission, obligation, advice or deduction. Past inference often uses modal plus have plus past participle.
items.translation: 情态动词表达能力、可能性、许可、义务、建议或推测。对过去情况的推测常用情态动词加 have 加过去分词。

items.subject: english
items.title: 非谓语动词
items.text: Infinitives, gerunds and participles can function as subjects, objects, complements, attributes or adverbials without serving as the finite predicate.
items.translation: 不定式、动名词和分词不作句子的限定谓语，可充当主语、宾语、补语、定语或状语。

items.subject: english
items.title: 名词性从句
items.text: Subject, object, predicative and appositive clauses function like nouns. The connector depends on meaning and on whether it has a grammatical role inside the clause.
items.translation: 主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句和同位语从句具有名词功能。连接词取决于句意，以及它是否在从句内部充当成分。

items.subject: english
items.title: 定语从句
items.text: Relative clauses modify a noun or pronoun. Restrictive clauses identify the referent; non-restrictive clauses add supplementary information and are set off by commas.
items.translation: 定语从句修饰名词或代词。限制性定语从句用于确定所指对象；非限制性定语从句补充信息，通常用逗号隔开。

items.subject: english
items.title: 时态与语态
items.text: Tense expresses the relationship between an event and a reference time. Voice shows whether the subject performs or receives the action.
items.translation: 时态表达事件与参照时间的关系，语态说明主语是动作执行者还是承受者。
